incident.title: Pod evicted from node: ephemeral-storage exhaustion

facts.message: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage. Threshold quantity: 2147483648, available: 534773760Ki.

evidence.summary: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
Pod has no ephemeral-storage requests or limits.
Node filesystem had approximately 512 MiB available near the incident.
Retrieved 1 application log entries around the incident window; no independent crash signature was established by the playbook.

hypotheses.statement: The application crashed independently of node resource pressure.
hypotheses.rationale: Contradicting: Pod terminal reason is Evicted. The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.

hypotheses.statement: The pod was evicted because the node was under memory pressure.
hypotheses.rationale: Contradicting: Node conditions: DiskPressure=True, MemoryPressure=False, PIDPressure=False.

hypotheses.statement: The pod was evicted because the node exhausted process IDs.
hypotheses.rationale: Contradicting: Node conditions: DiskPressure=True, MemoryPressure=False, PIDPressure=False.

hypotheses.statement: Node ephemeral-storage exhaustion triggered DiskPressure and pod eviction.
hypotheses.rationale: Supporting: Node conditions: DiskPressure=True, MemoryPressure=False, PIDPressure=False. Pod terminal reason is Evicted. The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage. Node filesystem had approximately 512 MiB available near the incident.

hypotheses.statement: Missing ephemeral-storage requests/limits allowed storage overcommit and contributed to the eviction.
hypotheses.rationale: Supporting: Pod has no ephemeral-storage requests or limits.

timeline.message: Evicted: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.

root_cause.title: Ephemeral-storage exhaustion caused kubelet eviction
root_cause.summary: The pod was evicted by kubelet while its node reported DiskPressure. Kubernetes explicitly identified ephemeral-storage as the scarce resource. The workload did not declare ephemeral-storage requests/limits, which can permit storage overcommit; that condition is treated as a contributing factor rather than the direct eviction trigger.

remediation.action: Define ephemeral-storage requests and limits for the affected workload after measuring normal and burst usage.
remediation.reason: Prevents unbounded local-storage consumption and improves scheduler accounting.

remediation.action: Alert on node filesystem availability and DiskPressure before kubelet eviction thresholds are reached.
remediation.reason: Provides lead time before workload eviction.

remediation.action: Identify high ephemeral-storage consumers on the node and validate log/cache/temp-file retention.
remediation.reason: Finds the workload or host path producing the storage pressure.

remediation.action: Review kubelet eviction thresholds and node root-volume sizing against observed production usage.
remediation.reason: Validates capacity and safety margins without masking runaway disk usage.
